title: When a healthcheck fails
statement: A container (plain Docker Engine, not Swarm) was started with `--restart always` and a HEALTHCHECK. Its check has now failed the configured number of retries in a row. Pick every one that applies.
choices: Its health status becomes unhealthy and `docker ps` shows (unhealthy)
The restart policy restarts it, since an unhealthy container counts as failed
It keeps running; Docker Engine itself takes no action on it
Docker sends it SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after the stop timeout
